title: LeadResponse
description: Contains the information on an account registration.

customerId.description: A unique ID for the customer (same as person ID)

location.description: A unique URL to be used by the customer for a personalized application flow

token.description: The token that should be sent to Lili Connect UI

partnerSuppliedId.description: The uniqueID provided by the partner in the Create Application call. Empty if none was supplied

personId.description: The unique ID of the registered person

metadata.description: The metadata key-value pairs stored on the customer

uboId.description: A unique ID for the UBO
